works.body:
Dear Dinosaul,It‘s me again(〃'▽'〃)
I wanna ask a AU for Maki&Lamia，the theme could be animals （Lamia is black catty，Maki is doggy）or fantasy stories.
https://photos.app.goo.gl/ega73m4UbqcSac119

Or  u can choose other charachters，Chino&Yuki,they are good friends.
https://photos.app.goo.gl/wCcCiwJLvNuY26UR7

Please change the clothes as you like.Have fun and draw freely!
Thank you for your time and consideration to look at my request!

🦖、Nice to meet you!! Your art is so cute ♥
I would like to request an illustration of my original characters.
The girl(she is 156 cm tall) named Lamia、she has black hair and brown skin.She is a dancer from Latin America.She is introvert and enthusiastic about life.
She fall in love with the boy at first seeing.
The blue hair boy(he is 168 cm tall) named Maki、he is a member of illegal organization.He wanna secede from it and married Lamia、but the boss thought this as a betrayal and shot Maki in front of Lamia.
Lamia died in love with Maki.

You can draw both of them or the the girl only,it's up to you.Please change the clothes as you like.Have fun and draw freely!

Thank you for your time and consideration to look at my request!

https://photos.app.goo.gl/ega73m4UbqcSac119
